THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT)
ACT, NO. 28 of 1964
Notice under Section 7

Reference . No.: NE/3/1/8/Acquisition/111/52. Land and Land Ministry Ref. 4/3/12/2013/CEB/31. I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment), Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intended to acquire the Description of the land to be acquired. Allotment of land called in Total Extent about 2.7444 Hectares described as Lots 278 to 283 Cadastral Map No. 330605 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in Talawakelle Village in Dimbula Korale Minor Division in Nuwara-Eliya Divisional Secretary’s Division, in Nuwara-Eliya District and bounded as follows:

01. Lot No. 278 Name of the Land: Hollyrood Estate; Details: Masonry Steps; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Chief Executive Officer, Thalawakale Plantation Company Limited, No. 25, Foster lane, Colombo 10; Extent: 0.0074 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 279 Name of the Land: Hollyrood Estate; Details: Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Chief Executive Officer, Thalawakale Plantation Company Limited, No. 25, Foster lane, Colombo 10; Extent: 0.3922 Hectare.

03. Lot No. 280 Name of the Land: Hollyrood Estate; Details: Garden contains 16 permanent buildings and two temporary buildings; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Chief Executive Officer, Thalawakale Plantation Company Limited, No. 25, Foster lane, Colombo 10; Extent: 0.7800 Hectare.

04. Lot No. 281 Name of the Land: Hollyrood Estate; Details: Low Jungle; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Chief Executive Officer, Thalawakale Plantation Company Limited, No. 25, Foster lane, Colombo 10; Extent: 0.4400 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 282 Name of the Land: Hollyrood Estate; Details: Garden contains 19 permanent buildings; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Chief Executive Officer, Thalawakale Plantation Company Limited, No. 25, Foster lane, Colombo 10; Extent: 1.1224 Hectares.

06. Lot No. 283 Name of the Land: Hollyrood Estate; Details: Masonry Steps; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Thalawakale Plantation limited Chief Executive Officer, Thalawakale Olantation Company Limited, No. 25, Foster lane, Colombo 10; Extent: 0.0024 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat on the 25th July 2018 at 10.00 a. m. and are
